name: Wet woods north-east of the forks, mid-July
note: The darkest palette here, and the dry accent is leaf litter on the floor rather than dead grass. Greens sampled from the July reference photographs used to judge this scene: James Woodworth Prairie Preserve, Glenview IL, 29 July 2021 (a Chicago-region tallgrass remnant) and a DuPage County tallgrass prairie, 24 July 2018. Those are modern remnants photographed in the right month at the right latitude, not evidence about 1835, which is why this record carries no source_id: colours here are render tuning and the evidence lives in the zone records.
